summary: Launch and legal-basis events added under decision 14 (drafted by one reader, confirmed blind by a second).

events.title: Bulgaria introduces investor citizenship scheme (year given by the Commission)
events.description: The European Commission's 2019 staff working document dates the introduction of Bulgaria's investor citizenship scheme to 2005.
events.quote: Bulgaria, Cyprus and Malta introduced such investor citizenship schemes in 2005, 2007 and 2013 respectively.

events.title: Commonwealth of Dominica Citizenship Act enacted
events.description: The Citizenship Act of 1978 provides the legal framework for naturalisation; according to the CBI Unit, sections 8 and 9 cover naturalisation of people taking part in Citizenship by Investment.
events.location: PDF p. 5, section 'Commonwealth of Dominica Citizenship Act'
events.quote: The Commonwealth of Dominica Citizenship Act, enacted in 1978, provides the legal framework for obtaining citizenship

events.title: Minister says the investment-based naturalisation scheme was introduced in 1988
events.description: Minister for Justice McDowell told the Dáil in 2002 that the scheme was introduced in 1988 on the initiative of the Minister for Industry and Commerce. The Department's 1998 review dates the Government decision to April 1989 (separate launch event).

events.title: Irish Nationality and Citizenship Act 1956, section 16 ('Irish associations')
events.description: Section 16 of the 1956 Act lets the Minister waive naturalisation conditions for applicants with 'Irish associations'; the Minister told the Dáil in 2004 that this phrase was the basis for the investment scheme. Section 10 of the 2004 Act narrowed it to end such schemes.
events.quote: putting such schemes beyond possibility for the future is to assign a clearly defined meaning to the phrase "Irish associations" in section 16 of the 1956 Act, which was the phrase used as the basis for the former scheme

events.title: Investor residence title created by the law of 8 March 2017 (date as given by the Finance Ministry)
events.description: The Finance Ministry's 2018 FAQ dates the law introducing the investor residence title (art. 53bis of the immigration law) to 8 March 2017; Bill 8586 gives 20 March 2017. Both kept side by side.
events.quote: loi du 8 mars 2017 portant modification de la loi modifiée du 29 août 2008 sur la libre circulation des

events.title: Migration procedure guidelines set the investor route to temporary residence
events.description: The Lineamientos para trámites y procedimientos migratorios (DOF 8 Nov 2012) allow temporary residence for an investor holding shares or business assets worth 20,000 days of the Federal District general minimum wage, or whose business creates five formal jobs; they entered into force the day after publication.
events.location: Transitorios, Primero; investor case under 'II. El supuesto de inversionista'
events.quote: Los presentes Lineamientos entrarán en vigor al día siguiente de su publicación en el Diario Oficial de la Federación.

events.title: High Net Worth Individuals (non-EU) rules take effect
events.description: L.N. 403 of 2011 (S.L. 123.130) gives a 15% tax status to non-EU nationals who buy property of at least EUR 400,000 or rent at EUR 20,000 a year; the consolidated text gives the commencement as 1 January 2011.
events.quote: HIGH NET WORTH INDIVIDUALS - NON-EU/EEA/SWISS NATIONALS RULES 1st January, 2011 * LEGAL NOTICE 403 of 2011

events.title: Act XV of 2013 creates the Individual Investor Programme route to citizenship
events.description: Act No XV of 2013 (Government Gazette No 19,166, 15 Nov 2013) amended the Maltese Citizenship Act so that a certificate of naturalisation could be granted through participation in an individual investor programme. Implementing regulations followed (L.N. 450 of 2013, revoked and replaced by L.N. 47 of 2014 on 4 Feb 2014).
events.quote: On 15 November 2013, the Republic of Malta adopted Act No XV of 2013: An Act to amend the Maltese Citizenship Act (Chapter 188 of the Laws of Malta) ( The Malta Government Gazette No 19,166, of 15 November 2013; ‘the 2013 amendment’). In parallel to the procedure laid down in Article 10(1) of the Maltese Citizenship Act, the 2013 amendment established the possibility for an applicant to be granted a certificate of naturalisation through participation in an ‘individual investor programme’

events.title: Residence permit for retired non-citizens created (Immigration Act s. 9B)
events.description: Section 9B, inserted into the Immigration Act by Act 21 of 2006 with effect from 1 October 2006, lets a retired non-citizen apply through the Board of Investment for a residence permit.
events.quote: [S. 9B inserted by s. 5 (g) of Act 21 of 2006 w.e.f. 1 October 2006.]

events.title: Investor 2 category takes effect
events.description: Immigration instructions BJ2.2, effective 27 July 2009, set out the points-based Investor 2 resident category requiring an NZ$1.5 million investment.
events.quote: invest NZ$1.5 million in New Zealand. Effective 27/07/2009

events.title: Migration regulation sets macro-enterprise investor residence (B/.160,000)
events.description: Decreto Ejecutivo 320 of 8 Aug 2008 (Gaceta 26104, 13 Aug 2008), arts. 185-186, lets foreigners who are sole holders of shares worth at least B/.160,000 in a company apply for residence. The decree states it takes effect on 26 August 2008.
events.quote: Podrán solicitar este permiso los extranjeros que deseen invertir en una ... macro-empresa, con un capital social mínimo de ciento sesenta mil balboas (B/.160,000.00) por solicitante

events.title: Permanent Residence Law No. 10 of 2018 published
events.description: Law No. 10 of 2018 on Permanent Residence, dated 4 Sept 2018, was published in the Official Gazette (issue 15) on 21 Oct 2018.
events.location: law card (بطاقة التشريع) on the Al Meezan page
events.quote: التاريخ: 04/09/2018 الموافق 13/12/1438 هجري عدد المواد: 13 الحالة: قيد التطبيق الجريدة الرسمية : العدد: 15 نسخة الجريدة الرسمية تاريخ النشر: 21/10/2018

events.title: Law No. 16 of 2018 on non-Qatari ownership and use of real estate
events.description: Law No. 16 of 2018 lets non-Qataris own and use real estate on conditions, benefits and procedures set by a Council of Ministers decision; Cabinet Decision No. 28 of 2020, which links residence to property purchases, was issued under it.
events.quote: this decision came within the executive procedures of Law No. 16 of 2018 regarding the regulation of non-Qatari ownership and use of real estate

events.title: 2013 amendments add an investor route to Seychelles citizenship (USD 1 million plus 11 years' residence)
events.description: The Immigration Department's November 2013 guide to the 2013 amendments to the Citizenship Act lists an investor category for citizenship: USD 1 million invested in a Seychelles business plus 11 years' aggregate residence.
events.location: PDF p. 7 (printed p. 5), Citizenship, Investor Type 1; overview PDF p. 3
events.quote: Has invested 1,000,000 US Dollars or more in a business in Seychelles and has resided for 11 years aggregate in Seychelles

events.title: Immigration Act of 1990 creates the EB-1 and EB-2 immigrant classifications the Gold Card relies on
events.description: Executive Order 14351 creates no new visa; it directs that the gift be treated as evidence of eligibility under 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(1)(A) and (b)(2)(A)-(B), the extraordinary-ability and exceptional-ability/national-interest-waiver classifications enacted by sec. 121 of the Immigration Act of 1990.

events.title: Immigration Visa Regulation No. 180 of 2011 sets up the Capital Investment Immigration Plan residence permit
events.description: The CIIP citizenship route created in 2013 requires the investor to have complied for 24 months with the Capital Investment Immigration Plan residence permit under the Immigration Visa Regulation No. 180 of 2011.
events.quote: the investor complies with the requirements of the Capital Investment Immigration Plan for a period of 24 months from the date of submission of his or her application for a residence permit under the Plan in the Immigration Visa Regulation No. 180 of 2011

events.title: Vanuatu Economic Rehabilitation Programme introduced (Treasury)
events.description: Treasury: the VERP fast-track citizenship programme was introduced in 2015 to raise revenue after Cyclone Pam, and phased out by March 2017.
events.quote: Vanuatu Economic Rehabilitation Programme (VERP) was introduced in 2015 aimed at raising revenue post Cyclone Pam through fast-track citizenship programme.
